summary: Five pixel stars that fill like liquid as you hover; picking one pops it with sparks and rolls the label.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when a new rating from 1 to 5 is picked by pointer, keyboard or `pick()`; a key that leaves the rating unchanged fires nothing.

methods.description: Sets the rating to 1 to 5 (rounded), pops the star, updates the label and ARIA values and fires `change`. Other values are ignored.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current rating from 1 to 5, or `0` before one is picked. Setting it (0 to 5) updates the stars, the label and the ARIA values without firing `change`.

keyboard.action: Raise the rating by one star.
Lower the rating by one star, to a minimum of one.

accessibility: The star canvas is focusable with `role="slider"`, `aria-label="Rating"`, `aria-valuemin="0"` and `aria-valuemax="5"`.
`aria-valuenow` and `aria-valuetext` (for example "4 of 5, Good") update when a rating is picked.
The word label is plain text that also previews the rating under the pointer; it is not a live region, so hovering is not announced.
motion: With reduced motion, stars fill at once without the wave and sparks are skipped; the picked star still pops briefly.
notes: The prompt "How was this answer?" and the labels Terrible, Not great, Okay, Good and Loved it are fixed.
The star canvas is a fixed 236 by 52px.
